statements.select:
SELECT C.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, C.CUST_ENG_NM, C.USER_CD, C.CUST_GRADE, CD.CODE_KOR AS CUST_GRADE_NM, U.USER_NM, C.DEPT_CD, DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(C.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM FROM T_CUSTOMER C LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER U ON C.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND C.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE CD ON C.CUST_GRADE = CD.CODE_ID WHERE C.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND (C.CUST_CD LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%' OR C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%')
AND (U.USER_CD LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%' OR U.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%') AND C.CUST_CD IS NOT NULL

SELECT U.USER_CD ,U.USER_NM ,U.DEPT_CD ,D.UP_DEPT_CD ,D.DEPT_NM ,U.O_PHONE ,U.M_PHONE ,U.EMAIL FROM T_USER AS U LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE U.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #up_dept_cd#
AND U.DEPT_CD = #dept_cd#
AND U.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%'
AND U.USER_CD = #user_cd#

SELECT K.KM_CD, K.KM_NM, K.SPTNR_CD, S.SPTNR_NM, K.KM_DEPT_NM, K.O_PHONE, K.M_PHONE, K.KM_EMAIL, K.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, KM_TITLE FROM T_KEYMAN AS K LEFT OUTER JOIN T_SA_PARTNER AS S ON K.COMPANY_CD = S.COMPANY_CD AND K.SPTNR_CD = S.SPTNR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER AS C ON K.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND K.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND K.KM_NM LIKE '%' + #km_nm# + '%'
AND K.KM_CD IN (#km_cds#)
AND K.KM_CD = #km_cd#
AND K.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND C.BCUST_CD = #bcust_cd#
AND K.CUST_GUBUN = #cust_gubun#
AND K.SPTNR_CD IN (SELECT SPTNR_CD FROM T_SA_PARTNER WHERE SPTNR_NM LIKE '%' + #sptnr_nm# + '%')

SELECT U.USER_CD ,U.USER_NM ,U.DEPT_CD ,D.DEPT_NM ,U.O_PHONE ,U.M_PHONE ,U.EMAIL FROM T_USER AS U LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE U.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND U.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #user_nm# + '%'
AND U.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #up_dept_cd#
AND U.DEPT_CD = #dept_cd#

SELECT A.SA_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_TYPE', A.SA_TYPE) AS SA_TYPE_NM , A.SA_CD , A.USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , SA_SDATE , isnull(SA_SDATE_TIME,'000000') AS SA_SDATE_TIME , SA_EDATE , isnull(SA_EDATE_TIME,'233000') AS SA_EDATE_TIME , A.CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , DBO.FN_GET_SALES_ACTIVITY_KEYMAN_CDS(A.COMPANY_CD, A.SA_CD) AS SA_KEYMAN_CDS , DBO.FN_GET_SALES_ACTIVITY_KEYMAN_NMS(A.COMPANY_CD, A.SA_CD) AS SA_KEYMAN_NMS , A.SA_CNCT , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_CNCT', A.SA_CNCT) AS SA_CNCT_NM , A.PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , A.SA_SUBJECT , A.SA_BODY , CASE WHEN A.CMT_YN = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DEPT_MGR) FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = A.USER_CD)) = 0 OR A.USER_CD != (SELECT DEPT_MGR FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = A.USER_CD)) THEN (SELECT (SELECT USER_POSIT FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = DEPT_MGR)+' : '+ISNULL(DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(DEPT_MGR), '')+' '+ISNULL('['+(SELECT DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, REG_DT, 112), 'YYYY-MM-DD')+']
'+SA_COMMENT FROM T_SA_COMMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND SA_CD = A.SA_CD AND CMT_MGR = AA.DEPT_MGR), '') FROM T_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD)+'

' ELSE '' END+ (SELECT (SELECT USER_POSIT FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = DEPT_MGR)+' : '+ISNULL(DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(DEPT_MGR), '')+' '+ISNULL('['+(SELECT DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, REG_DT, 112), 'YYYY-MM-DD')+']
'+SA_COMMENT FROM T_SA_COMMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND SA_CD = A.SA_CD AND CMT_MGR = AA.DEPT_MGR), '') FROM T_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = A.USER_CD))) +'

'+(SELECT (SELECT USER_POSIT FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = DEPT_MGR)+' : '+ISNULL(DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(DEPT_MGR), '')+' '+ISNULL('['+(SELECT DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, REG_DT, 112), 'YYYY-MM-DD')+']
'+SA_COMMENT FROM T_SA_COMMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND SA_CD = A.SA_CD AND CMT_MGR = AA.DEPT_MGR), '') FROM T_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = A.USER_CD)))) ELSE '' END AS SA_COMMENT , CASE WHEN A.SA_SDATE >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) THEN 'Y' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(SA_CD) FROM T_SA_COMMENT WHERE (SA_COMMENT IS NOT NULL AND SA_COMMENT != '') AND SA_CD = A.SA_CD ) = 0 AND CMT_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN (A.SA_BODY IS NULL OR CAST(A.SA_BODY AS NVARCHAR) = '') THEN 'Y' WHEN (A.SA_BODY IS NOT NULL AND CAST(A.SA_BODY AS NVARCHAR) != '') AND A.CMT_YN = 'N' AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DATEADD(D, 3, A.SA_EDATE), 112) >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EDIT_YN , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.NEXT_SA_SDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NEXT_SA_SDATE , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.NEXT_SA_EDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NEXT_SA_EDATE , A.NEXT_SA_TARGET , A.NEXT_SA_SUBJECT , DBO.FN_GET_SA_TARGETS(A.COMPANY_CD, A.SA_CD) AS SA_TARGETS , A.CMT_YN , DBO.FN_GET_USER_CDS(A.SA_CD) AS USER_CDS , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NMS(A.SA_CD) AS USER_NMS , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NMS_VIEW(A.SA_CD) AS USER_NMS_VIEW FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SA_CD = #sa_cd#
SELECT ITEM_LEVEL1 FROM T_ITEM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND ITEM_LEVEL1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ITEM_LEVEL1 ORDER BY ITEM_LEVEL1

SELECT ITEM_CD, ITEM_NM, ITEM_LEVEL1, ITEM_LEVEL2, ITEM_LEVEL3 FROM T_ITEM WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND (ITEM_CD LIKE '%' + #item# + '%' OR ITEM_NM LIKE '%' + #item# + '%')
AND ITEM_LEVEL1 = #item_level1#
ORDER BY ITEM_NM

SELECT CUST_CD AS EUSER_CD ,CUST_NM AS EUSER_NM ,CUST_ENG_NM AS EUSER_ENG_NM FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND (CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #euser_nm# + '%' OR CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #euser_nm# + '%')
AND (CUST_ENG_NM LIKE '%' + #euser_eng_nm# + '%' OR CUST_ENG_NM LIKE '%' + #euser_eng_nm# + '%')
AND CUST_CD = #euser_cd#

SELECT SR.COMPANY_CD, SR.SMR_CD, SR.SMR_CHASU, SR.ITEM_CD, SR.ITEM_NM, SR.EUSER_CD, SR.EUSER_NM, SR.SMP_RQTY, SR.PROJECT_POSS, SR.SMR_PODATE, SR.PUR_OQTY FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST SR LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SMR_CD,SMR_CHASU FROM T_SAMPLE) S ON SR.SMR_CD = S.SMR_CD AND SR.SMR_CHASU = S.SMR_CHASU WHERE SR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SMR_CD IS NULL
AND SR.EUSER_CD = #cust_cd#
AND SR.EUSER_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%'
AND SR.ITEM_NM LIKE '%' + #item_nm# + '%'
AND SR.SMP_STATUS = #smp_status#
AND SR.RRUSER_CD = #rruser_cd#
ORDER BY SR.SMR_CD DESC,SR.SMR_CHASU DESC

SELECT BASE_YR, BASE_CRNY, EXCH_RATE FROM T_BASE_CRNY WHERE 1=1
AND BASE_YR = #base_yr#
ORDER BY BASE_YR DESC, BASE_CRNY ASC

SELECT S.COMPANY_CD, S.SMP_CD, S.SMP_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, S.SMP_RTDATE, S.SMP_RTTYPE, S.SMP_RTDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_RETURN AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND S.SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu# AND S.SMP_SEQ = ( SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SMP_SEQ),1) SMP_SEQ FROM T_SMP_RETURN WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu# )

SELECT S.COMPANY_CD, S.SMP_CD, S.SMP_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, DP.DEPT_NM, S.SMP_DRDATE, S.SMP_DRTYPE, S.SMP_DRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_DROP S LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,USER_CD,USER_NM,DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,DEPT_CD,DEPT_NM,UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS DP ON U.COMPANY_CD = DP.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = DP.DEPT_CD
WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND S.SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu#

SELECT S.SMP_CD, S.SMP_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, S.SMP_CRDATE, S.SMP_CRTYPE, S.SMP_CRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_CREPAIR AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu#

SELECT S.SMP_CD, S.SMP_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, S.SMP_QRDATE, S.SMP_QRTYPE, S.SMP_QRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_QREPAIR AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu#

SELECT S.COMPANY_CD, S.SMP_CD, S.SMP_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, S.SMP_RTDATE, S.SMP_RTTYPE, S.SMP_RTDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_RETURN AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND S.SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu# AND S.SMP_SEQ = ( SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SMP_SEQ),1) SMP_SEQ FROM T_SMP_RETURN WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu# )

SELECT S.COMPANY_CD, S.SMR_CD, S.SMR_CHASU, S.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, S.SMR_RTDATE, S.SMR_RTTYPE, S.SMR_RTDESCRIPT FROM T_SMR_RETURN AS S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE S.SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND S.SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu# AND S.SMR_SEQ = ( SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SMR_SEQ),1) SMR_SEQ FROM T_SMR_RETURN WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu# )

SELECT A.SMP_CD , B.ITEM_CD , B.ITEM_NM , A.SMP_CHASU FROM ( SELECT U.SMP_CD, MAX(U.SMP_CHASU) AS SMP_CHASU, U.ITEM_CD FROM T_SAMPLE AS U LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE 1=1 AND U.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND U.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #up_dept_cd#
AND U.DEPT_CD = #dept_cd#
AND U.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND U.PRDT_PSBLT = #prdt_psblt#
AND U.CUST_CD IN (SELECT CUST_CD FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NM LIKE '%'+ #cust_nm# + '%')
GROUP BY U.SMP_CD, U.ITEM_CD ) A, T_ITEM B WHERE A.ITEM_CD = B.ITEM_CD
AND B.ITEM_NM LIKE '%'+ #item_nm# + '%'
